set.body: Browser pages (modules/surface-view-three/browser/index.html, examples/surface-view/browser/*.html) import Three.js from a hardcoded sibling path (../../../../../jscode/surfviewjs/node_modules/three/...), and jsSettingsBase links CommonJS. Consumers linking ESModule (neuropublish Vite) work, but the repo itself has no declared three version. Add a package.json pinning three (neuropublish uses 0.185.1) and an importmap relative to it; consider ESModule output for JS modules consumed from Vite. Acceptance: browser pages open from a clean checkout after npm install.
set.title: Pin Three.js and fix browser page import paths
